description: Build a Show Animation (212) or Show Balloon Icon (213) event command for insertion via insert_event_commands, played over a character (characterId: -1 player, 0 this event, N event id). Read-only: returns { command }.

characterId.description: Target character: -1 player, 0 this event, N event id on the current map

id.description: animation: the animation id; balloon: the balloon id (1 exclamation, 2 question, …)

kind.description: Play an animation or a balloon icon

wait.description: Hold the event until it finishes (default false)

name: build_character_effect
